name: JobHunt Full Stack
description: One app, built feature by feature with .NET and React in parallel: every day has a .NET 10 API lesson and a React + TypeScript lesson (about 30 minutes each) on the same feature. Track job applications, interviews and follow-ups; by week 21 it is tested, secured, observable, containerised and deployed.

weeks.title: Week 1: Two apps, one repo
weeks.objective: Set up the monorepo with a layered .NET solution and a Vite React + TypeScript app, and make them talk to each other.
weeks.deliverable: PR "Skeleton" merged: /api solution with 4 layers, /web Vite app, the web page shows the API's health status, both build in CI-ready scripts.

days.learn: Git monorepo layout; the .NET SDK and CLI; solutions vs projects; layered architecture
days.title: Monorepo with /api (Api, Application, Domain, Infrastructure projects + references) and a README

days.learn: Node, npm and Vite; TypeScript basics: types, interfaces, unions, strict mode
days.title: /web: Vite React + TypeScript app in strict mode, ESLint + Prettier, first typed component

days.learn: Minimal APIs, Program.cs and the request pipeline; configuration and environments
days.title: GET /health endpoint returning status, version and environment

days.learn: CORS and the browser same-origin policy; fetch + async/await; useEffect basics
days.title: Health badge in the web app that calls /health (CORS configured for the dev origin)

days.learn: Scripts that run both apps; .gitignore for .NET + Node; commit hygiene
days.title: One command to run API + web together, documented in the README

weeks.checkpoint: From a blank folder: a minimal API with one endpoint and a React page that shows its JSON, in 25 minutes

weeks.title: Week 2: The job-search domain in C# and TypeScript
weeks.objective: Model applications, companies and interviews in modern C# with rules and tests, mirror them as TypeScript types, and render them with components.
weeks.deliverable: PR "Domain model" merged: domain entities with guarded status transitions and xUnit tests (80% on Domain); TS types and a static list rendered from components.

days.title: TS types mirroring the domain + ApplicationCard and ApplicationList components

days.learn: State with useState; derived state; lifting state up
days.title: Static sample data with a status filter in the list (client side)

weeks.checkpoint: From a blank file: a record, an enum, one guarded transition with a Theory test, and a typed React component that renders it

weeks.deliverable: PR "Applications list" merged: GET /api/applications (in-memory store behind an interface) and a list page with loading, empty and error states.
